title: AI and Development: Acceleration or Widening Gaps
discussion_signal: The World Bank relay frames AI capability as dependent on electricity, broadband, skills, computing capacity, locally relevant data, and institutions. Comments reinforce that adoption without these complements may widen rather than close development gaps.
linked_research_question: When AI expands capability, which local complements and governance capacities determine whether gains are inclusive or concentrated?
limits: The post is a report and podcast relay, not an outcome evaluation
Infrastructure presence does not establish equitable capability
